search_results.description: The article reviews five creatine gummies or chews, emphasizing that creatine monohydrate is the best-supported form and that a daily dose of about 5 grams is generally needed for strength and muscle benefits. Because some gummies have been found to contain less creatine than their labels claim, the experts recommend third-party testing, especially NSF Certified for Sport or Informed Sport certification. The picks are Momentous Creatine Chews, the best overall: NSF-certified, vegan, gluten-free, and made with Creapure, though five chews are needed for 5 grams. Legion provides 5 grams per serving but includes 8 grams of added sugar. Create offers 4.5 grams, relatively little added sugar, NSF certification, and published Eurofins test reports. Bear Balanced uses Creapure and has no added sugar, but contains maltitol that may upset sensitive stomachs, and its testing agency is undisclosed. Beast Bites delivers 5 grams of Creapure and is NSF-certified, with the added advantage of being made in an allergen-free facility, though it has 8 grams of added sugar. Gummies are convenient but can cost roughly three times more than powder.
